name: bizplug-moving-storage
description: The moving & storage plug-in from BizPlug. Main function: moving estimate and storage rates. It works from the business's own published profile, covering move sizes, storage and quote requests, and sends requests to the business to confirm. It never takes payment and only shares what the business has published. Provided by BizPlug: https://bizplug.ai, info@bizplug.ai.

interface.shortDescription: Moving estimate and storage rates for moving & storage businesses.
